exitGate.additionalConditions: Practice/firm authority, insurance, tax/health/eTIMS, lawful data transfers, employment/notice, benefits replacement and tested delivery capacity; no presumed VAT relief/Wise wallet.

runwayRows.action: Confirm personal budget, employment restrictions and ICPAK status; ring-fence funds.
QBO core training; synthetic sample bank reconciliation and month-end pack.

Complete Xero training and two synthetic portfolio cases; after compliance and readiness gates, begin targeted outreach and a small paid pilot only if ready. Otherwise defer this month’s illustrative receipts.
Expand targeted outreach after compliance; continue the bounded pilot and seek repeat work. If the January pilot was deferred, shift collections and recompute the exit date.
Referrals and weekly pipeline review; measure actual time and collections.
Convert pilot to monthly close retainer; document SOP and client access.
Seek second/third independent recurring client; review pricing and capacity.
Cull low-margin work; quantify paid hours versus admin; check tax instalments.
Test backup internet and absence cover; no exit based on one good month.
First qualifying revenue month only if actually collected; verify client concentration.
Second qualifying month; review next-quarter recurring commitments and notice.
Third qualifying month; recompute actual cash, tax, health and licensing costs.
